items.text:
The user is asking me to proofread "today's draft" (校一下今天的稿). Looking at my memories:
Sure. Paste the draft here, or tell me which article it is, and I'll pick at the wording right away.
先找一下工作区里有没有今天的稿；没有正文我没法校。

The user asked me to proofread today's draft ("校一下今天的稿"). According to the memory:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have the draft text to review. Could you paste the article or tell me which piece you’d like checked? Once I see the words, I’ll tighten the phrasing for you.
工作区里全是代码文档。再看一眼 `docs/` 和今天改过的文件，确认有没有稿。

The user asked me to proofread today's draft ("校一下今天的稿"). Based on my memory:
I can help with proofreading, but since you didn't include the draft text this time, I'll need you to paste it so I can review it properly. Once you share it, I can focus on tightening wording, shortening sentences, and making sure it flows cleanly without any extra sentences after thanks.

「今天的稿」没指到具体篇目，正文也没贴出来。

更干净的说法：把要校的那篇贴过来，或写清文件名。
还是校一下今天的稿，按你规范提议设成例程。
The user wants me to proofread today's manuscript again, and they want me to propose setting this as a routine according to my behavioral norms.

「今天的稿」还是没点篇目，也没贴正文，没法校。

更干净：把要校的正文贴过来，或写清文件名。

items.name: 校今天的稿
items.instruction: 校对当天的稿：先点含糊处，再给一版更干净的句子。术语保留英文，不改专有名词。用户未贴正文、未指明篇目时，只说明缺什么，不要顺口揽活。
